# hexpic

> High-performance TypeScript library, headless Node engine, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for converting raster graphics into studio-quality ASCII art and visual layout contour maps using error-diffusion dithering (Atkinson, Floyd-Steinberg, JJN, Stucki) and 3x3 Sobel/unsharp convolutions.

HexPic runs in both browser and headless Node.js environments. In the browser, it renders via HTML5 Canvas or declarative `<img data-hexpic>`. In headless Node.js and MCP environments, it decodes PNG and JPEG buffers in pure JavaScript without requiring native compilation or GUI display servers.

When operating as an AI tool or MCP server, HexPic enables models to inspect, summarize, and render visual content in dense character grids without consuming expensive image vision tokens. Monospace typefaces have an inherent aspect ratio of approximately 0.55 (characters are taller than wide); HexPic automatically counters this vertical stretching unless `preserveAspectRatio: false` is explicitly passed.

## Architecture & Interfaces

<doc title="TypeScript Types and API Reference" path="src/types.ts">
```typescript
export type DitheringMode = 'none' | 'floyd-steinberg' | 'atkinson' | 'jjn' | 'stucki';
export type ColorMode = 'monochrome' | 'color';

export type CharsetPreset =
  | 'minimalist'    // '#+-.'
  | 'normal'        // '@%#*+=-:.'
  | 'normal2'       // '&$Xx+;:.'
  | 'alphabetic'    // A-Z
  | 'alphanumeric'  // A-Za-z0-9
  | 'numerical'     // 0896452317
  | 'extended'      // '@%#{}[]()<>^*+=~-:.'
  | 'math'          // '+-×÷=≠≈∞√π'
  | 'arrow'         // '↑↗→↘↓↙←↖'
  | 'grayscale'     // Extended 70-character gradation
  | 'max'           // 180+ international density matrix
  | 'codepage437'   // '█▓▒░'
  | 'blockelement'  // '█▀▄▌▐░▒▓'
  | 'braille';      // '⣿⣶⣤⣀'

export interface AsciiArtOptions {
  width?: number;                  // Output character columns (default: 80)
  height?: number;                 // Output character rows (auto-computed if omitted)
  charset?: CharsetPreset | string;// Character set preset name or custom sequence
  dithering?: DitheringMode;       // Error diffusion algorithm (default: 'none')
  colorMode?: ColorMode;           // 'monochrome' (plain text) or 'color' (HTML spans)
  invert?: boolean;                // Invert luminance (default: false)
  contrast?: number;               // 0 to 300, where 100 is normal
  brightness?: number;             // 0 to 300, where 100 is normal
  saturation?: number;             // 0 to 400, where 100 is normal (canvas only)
  hue?: number;                    // 0 to 360 degrees (canvas only)
  grayscale?: number;              // 0 to 100 grayscale filter intensity
  sepia?: number;                  // 0 to 100 sepia intensity (canvas only)
  useSharpen?: boolean;            // Apply 3x3 unsharp convolution kernel
  sharpness?: number;              // Center kernel weight (1 to 20, default: 9)
  useEdgeDetection?: boolean;      // Apply 3x3 Sobel gradient edge detection
  edgeIntensity?: number;          // Sobel magnitude multiplier (0.1 to 3.0, default: 1.0)
  invertEdgeColors?: boolean;      // Dark edges vs light edges (default: true)
  useThreshold?: boolean;          // Binary threshold cutoff
  thresholdOffset?: number;        // Threshold cutoff (0 to 255, default: 128)
  spaceDensity?: number;           // Padding spaces added to light palette end (default: 1)
  transparentFrame?: number;       // Outer character border padding (default: 0)
  preserveAspectRatio?: boolean;   // Counter font height distortion (default: true)
  backgroundColor?: string;        // Hex/RGB background color (default: '#000000')
  textColor?: string;              // Foreground text color (default: '#ffffff')
  fontAspectRatio?: number;        // Width-to-height ratio of font (default: 0.55)
}

export interface AsciiArtResult {
  ascii: string;                   // Monospace plain text string
  html: string;                    // HTML representation with styled <span> tags
  width: number;                   // Final width in characters
  height: number;                  // Final height in characters
  charset: string;                 // Resolved character string used
  colors?: CharColor[][];          // 2D grid of RGB values per character if colorMode is 'color'
  copyToClipboard(): Promise<void>;// Copy plain text to system clipboard
  saveAsText(filename?: string): void; // Browser file download
  saveAsPng(filename?: string, fontSize?: number, bg?: string, fg?: string): void;
  toPngDataUrl(fontSize?: number, bg?: string, fg?: string): string;
  toPngBlob(fontSize?: number, bg?: string, fg?: string): Promise<Blob>;
  toSvg(fontSize?: number, bg?: string, fg?: string): string;
  saveAsSvg(filename?: string, fontSize?: number, bg?: string, fg?: string): void;
  toSvgBlob(fontSize?: number, bg?: string, fg?: string): Promise<Blob>;
}
```
</doc>

## Model Context Protocol (MCP)

<doc title="Model Context Protocol Server Specification" path="src/mcp/server.ts">
The official MCP server communicates over standard input/output (`stdio`) and provides structured JSON tools for AI agents.

### Connecting to the MCP Server

Add to `claude_desktop_config.json`, `cursor_settings.json`, or Antigravity configuration:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hexpic": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "hexpic-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Or for local development inside this repository:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hexpic": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["./dist/bin/hexpic-mcp.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Available Tools

#### 1. `convert_image`
Converts an image into an ASCII character grid with optional dithering and edge detection.
- **Parameters**:
  - `source` (string, required): Local file path (`./diagram.png`), remote HTTP(S) URL (`https://...`), or base64 data URI (`data:image/png;base64,...`).
  - `width` (integer, 10-300, optional, default: 80): Output columns.
  - `height` (integer, 5-300, optional): Output rows.
  - `dithering` ("none" | "atkinson" | "floyd-steinberg" | "jjn" | "stucki", optional, default: "none").
  - `charset` (string, optional, default: "normal").
  - `colorMode` ("monochrome" | "color", optional, default: "monochrome").
  - `useEdgeDetection` (boolean, optional, default: false).
  - `edgeIntensity` (number, 0.1-3.0, optional, default: 1.0).
  - `useSharpen` (boolean, optional, default: false).
  - `contrast` (number, 0-300, optional, default: 100).
  - `brightness` (number, 0-300, optional, default: 100).
  - `invert` (boolean, optional, default: false).
  - `format` ("text" | "html" | "svg", optional, default: "text"): Output representation. When "svg" is passed, returns a standalone SVG string ready for Markdown embeds.

#### 2. `analyze_spatial_layout`
Generates an edge contour map and quadrant density distribution report to help text-only models perceive visual composition and object positions.
- **Parameters**:
  - `source` (string, required): Image path, URL, or data URI.
  - `width` (integer, 10-120, optional, default: 60): Character resolution of the contour map.
  - `edgeIntensity` (number, 0.1-3.0, optional, default: 1.2): Edge detection sensitivity.
- **Return Value**:
  - Quadrant edge density breakdown (`Top-Left`, `Top-Right`, `Bottom-Left`, `Bottom-Right`, `Center Density`).
  - ASCII edge outline diagram.

#### 3. `get_presets`
Returns all supported character set presets, dithering algorithms, and use-case recommendations. Takes no parameters.
</doc>

## Headless Node.js Usage

<doc title="Headless Node and Pure Pixel Execution" path="src/HexPic.ts">
To convert raw pixel buffers in Node.js, Web Workers, or serverless functions without a canvas:

```typescript
import { HexPic } from 'hexpic';
import { decodeImageBuffer, resolveImageSource } from 'hexpic/node';

const buffer = await resolveImageSource('./avatar.png');
const { data, width, height } = decodeImageBuffer(buffer);

const hexpic = new HexPic();
const result = hexpic.fromPixels(data, width, height, {
  width: 80,
  dithering: 'atkinson',
  charset: 'blockelement'
});

console.log(result.ascii);
```
</doc>

## CLI & GitHub Action Integration

<doc title="HexPic Command-Line Interface (CLI)" path="bin/hexpic.ts">
The CLI can be invoked via `npx hexpic [image] [options]`.
Flags:
- `-o, --output`: Destination file path (`.svg`, `.txt`, `.html`). Defaults to stdout.
- `-f, --format`: Output format: `svg`, `text`, or `html`.
- `-w, --width`: Character column width (default: 70).
- `--height`: Character row height.
- `-c, --color-mode`: `color` or `monochrome` (default: `color`).
- `-d, --dithering`: `atkinson`, `floyd-steinberg`, `bayer`, `none` (default: `atkinson`).
- `--charset`: Built-in preset name or custom string.
- `--font-size`: Monospace font size in pixels for SVG rendering (default: 12).
- `--bg`: Background color for SVG (default: #000000).
- `--fg`: Foreground text color for monochrome SVG (default: #ffffff).
</doc>

<doc title="Official GitHub Action" path="action.yml">
Automate SVG banner generation for GitHub profile READMEs:
```yaml
- uses: DanielKinnito/hexpic@main
  with:
    # Defaults to repository owner avatar (https://github.com/<owner>.png)
    output: './assets/hexpic.svg'
    width: '70'
    color-mode: 'color'
    dithering: 'atkinson'
```
</doc>
